title: unit_h*T_h IS an autocorrelation; its b-DFT is a power spectrum (no L1 tight)
reduced_to: Bounding B = max_{b!=0}|eta_b| for thin dyadic mu_n -- i.e. the worst-case Gauss-period / generalized-Paley non-principal eigenvalue (the spectral form is exact and manifestly nonnegative, but the worst frequency stays open).
evidence: Two exact-arithmetic probes in scripts/probes/_407_conn/ at PROPER-subgroup prize primes (dyadic mu_n=ker(chi), q prime =1 mod n, q ~ n^4 with n < sqrt(q), n=8/16/32, 2 primes each: q in {1657,1697,3617,3697,7873,7937}). HEADLINE CONFIRMED EXACT. (1) C094_house_exact.py: the per-frequency power-spectrum identity |eta_b|^2 == A0/m^2 + (sqrt(p)/m)*Re(S_b), where S_b = Sum_{h!=0} unit_h*T_h*chi^h(b), unit_h = conj(tau_h)/sqrt(p), holds to ~1e-10 (machine) at EVERY prime (errs 6.8e-12 .. 1.3e-10). So the b-DFT of the tangent sequence (unit_h*T_h) IS literally the Gauss-period power spectrum |eta_b|^2 up to the exact Parseval shift A0/m^2 = ((m-1)p+1)/m^2 (verified A0=(m-1)p+1 exactly; A0/m^2 == avg_b|eta_b|^2 to 4 decimals). (2) S_b is REAL (max imag part 2.7e-11 .. 4.2e-10) and equals an affine image of |eta_b|^2 with residual 3e-11 .. 4e-10 -> manifestly a nonnegative power spectrum (Wiener-Khinchin), so 'no L1/triangle bound is tight, but the spectral/positivity restatement is Parseval-exact' is CORRECT. (3) ALGEBRAIC ROOT pinned: unit_h*T_h = A_h/(m*sqrt(p)) for h!=0 (since |tau_h|^2=p), where A_h=Sum_j tau_j conj(tau_{j+h}) is the Gauss-sum autocorrelation; hence (sqrt p/m)*S_b = (1/m^2)Sum_{h!=0} A_h chi^h(b) = |eta_b|^2 - A0/m^2 by identity I2. The whole thing is just the DFT of the autocorrelation A_h minus its h=0 term -- a Parseval/Wiener-Khinchin tautology, exact and sign-blind. CORRECTED the connection's literal formula: T_h = A_h*tau_h/(m p) (err 5e-12), NOT the recorded (conj(tau_h)/(mp))*A_h; and Hasse-Davenport is tau_h*tau_{-h}=chi^h(-1)*p (err 1.9e-9), so the chi^h(-1) the JSON puts on the unit factor is misplaced. The structural claim survives the typos.
honest_note: PARTIAL, NOT a closure. (a) The PROVEN piece is genuine, exact, and clean: |eta_b|^2 = A0/m^2 + (sqrt p/m)Re(Sum_{h!=0} unit_h T_h chi^h(b)) is an algebraic identity (b-DFT of the tangent sequence = power spectrum), confirming the connection's central insight that (unit_h*T_h) IS a normalized autocorrelation and its spectrum is manifestly nonnegative -- which is exactly why the refuted L1/triangle route (sqrt n * m^{1/4}) cannot be tight (it discards the h-cancellation that Parseval keeps). This duplicates/sharpens what C021 (r_hat(b)=|eta_b|^2) and C079 (raw-moment law) already established on the additive side, now re-derived on the TANGENT side and tied to it by the exact unit_h*T_h = A_h/(m sqrt p). (b) But it is a RESTATEMENT/relocation, NOT a bound. It rewrites the house B^2 = max_b|eta_b|^2 = A0/m^2 + (sqrt p/m)max_b Re S_b without bounding max_b Re S_b; the prize content (the sup-norm flatness max_{b!=0}|eta_b| <= (1+o(1))sqrt(n log m)) is untouched. The probes confirm the wall is fully present: B/2sqrt(n) = 1.29..1.73 > 1 everywhere (non-Ramanujan), B/sqrt(n ln m) = 1.1..1.5 (rising, the #400-trap small-q inflation). The connection's OWN attack_plan/title already concedes 'no L1 bound is tight' -- correct -- and the positivity restatement, while exact, gives no upper bound on the worst frequency. (c) Power spectra are nonnegative for EVERY sequence; nonnegativity of |eta_b|^2 is free (it's a square) and carries zero information about its max. So the spectral/Parseval-exact form welds directly back to BGK: bounding max_{b!=0}|eta_b| for thin dyadic mu_n = the generalized-Paley non-principal eigenvalue = the 25-year-open Paley Graph / BGK sqrt-cancellation problem (best PROVEN n^{1-o(1)}; Ramanujan B<=2sqrt(n) open). Probes: scripts/probes/_407_conn/C094_power_spectrum.py, C094_house_exact.py.
